title: CIBMTR - Equity in Post-HCT Survival Predictions
description: Built Cox Proportional Hazards survival model achieving C-index of 0.6688 on 28,800 transplant patients with 103 clinical features. Stratified patients into 4 risk groups with 4.59x hazard ratio between highest/lowest risk. Identified 62 statistically significant predictors using survival analysis techniques and PCA feature engineering.
